variables.toolTip:
If a preset asset has a UDS Modifier asset selected here, UDW will apply that modifier to UDS, based on how much this preset is currently affecting the local weather.
This can allow a custom preset to have additional effects on any of the properties on UDS exposed to the Sky Modifier system. For more info on sky modifiers and how to make them, see the documentation entry on them in the sky section of the readme.
